# GitHub Copilot

Use [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) as the shared project guidance. Read it explicitly before changing files if its contents are not already loaded. Keep project rules there; this file provides the Copilot entry point.

In VS Code and VS Code Insiders, instruction discovery depends on the selected agent harness and its settings. Supported Copilot sessions can discover root `AGENTS.md` alongside this repository instruction file. Check the chat's instruction references and open `AGENTS.md` manually if absent; this link alone does not guarantee loading. Do not change editor or personal settings to activate instructions.

See the [official VS Code instruction documentation](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/agent-customization/custom-instructions) for discovery details. Keep both files consistent when a verified project change requires an instruction update.
